books.title: Stepmother Supreme (AKA Yunchu's Vengeance)
books.author: Zhao Yunzi
books.synopsis:
[Film/TV rights already sold. Drama titled  Yunchu's Vengeance to be released 2026]

In her past life, Yun Chu devoted herself entirely to supporting her husband, raising his illegitimate children, and helping the Xie family rise to power and prominence — only to be repaid with the most brutal betrayal. The entire Yun clan, over a hundred people, was executed. And the very child she had raised with her own hands forced poisoned wine down her throat.
As the poison burned through her, she made one vow: if she ever got another life, she would make every one of them suffer a hundredfold.
She fought with everything she had to break free from the endless cycle of fate — and was reborn at the age of twenty.
She opens her eyes to find a row of Xie family children standing before her, each warmly calling her "Mother." These are the very people who destroyed the Yun clan, and she intends to spare not a single one.
The eldest loves studying? Then she'll cut off his path to a career in officialdom. The second loves martial arts? She'll make sure he can never set foot in the military. The eldest daughter craves power and status? She'll arrange a noble marriage — and a lifetime of widowhood. The youngest is useless? Then let him fend for himself.
On this path of revenge, Yun Chu will show no mercy.
But then —
"Mama!"
"You're our mama!"
Two soft little children press into her arms.
A man stands before her: "I raised them for four years. Now it's your turn."

books.title: Red Dust From Every Side (Love in Red Dust)
books.author: You Si Jie
books.synopsis:
Being an executioner sounds frightening, but it's just a way to earn a living.

When the legitimate daughter of the Wen family, Wen Dingyi, was young, her father committed a crime. Overnight, their prosperity collapsed, and their life of silken clothes and jade meals seemed like just a dream. The family members either died or were exiled, leaving only her, rescued by her wet nurse.

To survive, Dingyi disguised herself as a boy and apprenticed under Wu Changgeng, the most famous executioner of Shuntian Prefecture. Through winter and summer, she grew to seventeen years old.

One day, she left home without checking the almanac and carelessly offended the Seventh Prince. To him, a descendant of the imperial family, looking at her was no different from looking at an insect. Just as Dingyi was about to be dragged away and chopped like a melon, with her life hanging by a thread, someone strolled over and, with a few casual words, saved her little life.

He wore an official uniform of bluish-gray with embroidered dragons, had refined features, and a jade-like profile. That air of dignity looking down upon all living beings was unforgettable to her for life.

Much, much later, Dingyi once asked him about his first impression of her. He raised an eyebrow and said, "Short, effeminate, standing under the blazing sun with your head tilted and eyes squinting, like a simpleton."

Dingyi: "…"

books.title: After Rebirth, I Become The Emperor's White MoonLight
books.author: 多多亦杉
books.synopsis:
Jiang Mi is the Empress Dowager's niece — a woman who was forced upon the Emperor. Even knowing full well that her imperial cousin held no affection for her, she had stubbornly followed her heart into his inner palace. A great deal of scheming, and yet her end had not been a pleasant one.

After her rebirth, Jiang Mi came to her senses. Rather than waste a lifetime on an Emperor whose heart would never be hers, she would find herself someone who actually cherished her.

The young master of the Grand Councillor's family — refined and courteous. The young master of the Loyal Valor Marquis's household — gallant and handsome. The heir of the Duke Zhenguo's estate — gentle and agreeable. Jiang Mi counted her prospects on her fingers, quietly mapping out her plans.

When the Empress Dowager sought a boon from the new Emperor on her niece's behalf, everyone assumed the Jiang family would seize the opportunity to secure Jiang Mi a place in the imperial harem.

The new Emperor watched calmly as Jiang Mi, cheeks flushed, murmured in a small voice: "This subject's daughter wishes to… to ask Your Majesty to grant her a marriage decree."

The Emperor, ordinarily so temperate and gracious, let a flash of something dangerous cross his eyes. The jade archer's ring he had been turning idly between his fingers crumbled to dust.

books.title: The house Is On fire
books.author: Fang Chen Yi
books.synopsis:
Slow-burn romance · Marry first, fall in love later · Both leads untouched · Family drama in an ancient noble household

The moment Qin Ruyin opened her eyes, she found herself transmigrated into the body of a legitimate daughter of a prominent official family in the Great Ying Dynasty. Before she could even begin to enjoy the privileges of wealth and status, she was blindsided by her cousin Qin Ruyue's scheming switcheroo marriage plot.

Qin Ruyue had been reborn. In her previous life, she had married the widowed and supremely powerful Lord Jiang — a man at the very pinnacle of imperial authority. She had assumed a life of endless luxury awaited her, only to find him cold and indifferent, utterly unmoved no matter how desperately she tried to win his favor.

Refusing to accept her fate, she turned the inner household upside down with her tantrums — only for the Jiang family to fall from grace, leaving her divorced and sent back in disgrace, the laughingstock of the entire capital. Upon her rebirth, she discovered that Qin Ruyin — the cousin she had always looked down on in her past life — was about to receive a marriage proposal from the Wang family. The Wang family, who would one day command power over the entire court! There was absolutely no way she was letting Qin Ruyin have that.

So she went weeping to her grandmother, begging for a marriage swap, and successfully offloaded her "cold and heartless ex-husband" onto her cousin.

Qin Ruyin: Wait, there's a deal this good? She quietly looked into it:

Lord Jiang has no interest in women? Perfect — that's exactly what she wanted.
The inner household is clean, with no concubines or serving girls? Ideal!
Her mother-in-law won't make her life difficult? This marriage might as well have been custom-made for her.

All she had ever wanted was to live out her days in peace. Since her cousin didn't want this marriage, she was more than happy to take it off her hands. All she had to do was walk in with a generous dowry, keep her head down, make no demands, and coast through life in comfortable mediocrity. Easy.

Or so she thought.

As it turned out, Lord Jiang wasn't cold-blooded at all. Nor did his tastes lie elsewhere. No — he was more like a house that had been empty for years: the moment a single spark caught, the whole thing went up in flames, and there was simply no stopping it.

Later, she would often wonder: she had signed up for a quiet, effortless life — so how exactly did she end up with a husband completely and utterly obsessed with spoiling her?

recommendations.blurb: Chasing wife to crematorium emperor version

books.title: Peeking at Spring's Affection
books.author: Qiong Yu
books.synopsis:
After her mother's death, Shen Weici is left utterly alone, drifting like a rootless weed. She travels a great distance to the capital to seek out her relatives.

Upon first entering the Marquis's estate, she treads carefully, facing difficulties at every turn — yet throughout it all she remains quiet and gentle, with no desire to take a single thing from the household. She only wishes to find herself a suitable marriage and a small corner of peace to call her own.

Song Zhang, the capital's notorious "Lord of Hell," is a man of noble lineage who holds great power and regards everyone beneath him with contempt.

When he first lays eyes on Shen Weici, he is full of disdain and makes things difficult for her.

Later, he notices her smiling shyly at another man, her beautiful eyes alluring as a fox spirit's — and he scoffs coldly as he walks away, only to secretly destroy the promising match behind her back.

He watches her face him with reddened eyes, demanding to know why. He answers with a lazy, wicked smile: *"Zhang the Second placed first in the imperial exams young and comes from a distinguished family — who do you think you are to cling to him? If you want a peaceful life, why not beg me? I might just grant you the position of honored concubine."*

But the tables turn swiftly. In the end, it is he who kneels at her door, eyes red and pleading:

*"Ah Ci… I'm begging you…"*

*"Don't carve out my heart…"*

He had used every dark means at his disposal for her sake — and only in the end did he realize he had already fallen beyond saving.

books.title: We Agreed to divorce, Yet You Hold Me Every Night
books.author: Happy Pearl
books.synopsis:
Lu Huaixi had been slipped onto the list of girls entering the imperial palace. Left with no good options, she got engaged to Xie Yuanjing — a man she had absolutely nothing to do with. A one-year agreement. Each getting what they need. After the separation, their marriages would be none of each other's business. Lu Huaixi was perfectly satisfied with this.

But Xie Yuanjing seemed a little *too* good to her — and she found herself sinking in, just a tiny bit.

Xie Yuanjing brought home a young girl and treated her like a child to look after — proper and upright, letting her do as she pleased. But the girl was too good. He sank in. He couldn't stand to see her grow close to others, couldn't stand to see her smile at someone else, couldn't stand to see her distance herself from him. He wanted to trade everything good he had just to make her stay.

Later, when the Lu family patriarch was wondering where his daughter could go after the separation, Young Master Xie pulled her back behind him.

"Separation? There's no such thing."

books.title: After The General's first Love Returns
books.author: 宇宙第一红
books.synopsis:
It took Bai Qingning three years to marry her husband, and she realized that she had never been in his heart.

After her husband's beloved Zhao Hongzhu returned, he ignored her and even killed her. He sought a position for a newcomer, but his relatives watched coldly. His loyal servants were displaced and separated, and when he was about to die, he even brought her mute slave to die with him.

With one more eye open, Bai Qingning returned to the year Zhao Hongzhu had just returned.

She used every possible means, bit by bit, to drag all the scumbags and bitches into the endless abyss, and then she relaxed and separated, picked up her mute slave and took good care of him.

And the slave? He was a lowly creature who had fallen into a ditch, a slave who had never seen light, and she was his moonlight. A moonlight he did not dare to look at with his eyes, fearing that the moonlight would see the greed he tried to hide, so he lowered his head and looked at the moon's shadow in the cup. But he had a secret. Maybe one day he can look directly at the moon.

books.title: After the Mad Tyrant's Rebirth, She Was Taken by Force
books.author: Qiong Yu
books.synopsis:
They say the reigning emperor is cold and ruthless, his moods as unpredictable as the wind, rarely gracing the inner palace with his presence — until the fourth daughter of the Xi family entered the court.

To say that among three thousand women in the harem, he favored only her alone would not be an exaggeration.

He bestowed upon her the character *Chen*, then granted her Chenqian Palace — the grandest and closest to his own quarters. Within a mere half year, she rose from the rank of Zhaoyi to the head of the Four Consorts.

He even had honeydew melons transported from two thousand li away, delivered to her door each and every day — all because she was fond of them.

All of it, just to coax a smile from his beauty.

Yet no one knew that this same Consort Chen, she who reigned supreme in the inner palace, would one day be found huddled in the corner of a resplendent golden hall, tears blurring her vision, watching with frightened eyes as a figure draped in shadow slowly approached.

The faint clinking of iron chains drifted through the air.

The tall man clad in imperial yellow knelt on one knee before Xi Rongyan

books.title: Fated Hearts
books.author: Chi Yi Qian Yu
books.synopsis:
On the blood-soaked fields of Pingling, the red-clad archer Fu Yi Xiao unleashes a single, peerless arrow—striking down Feng Sui Ge, Su Sha's proud eldest prince, and changing the course of the war. Yet triumph turns to tragedy when fate casts her from a cliff, stealing her memories and leaving her adrift in a world she no longer knows.

Wounded and hunted, Feng Sui Ge stumbles into Zhengnian Villa, only to be confronted by the woman who once brought him to his knees. But this Fu Yi Xiao is different—her eyes no longer burn with enmity, her heart no longer remembers their war. Torn between vengeance and suspicion, Feng Sui Ge keeps her close, determined to uncover the unseen hand pulling their nations into chaos.

What begins as a fragile alliance soon ignites into something far more dangerous—a bond forged in stolen glances, unspoken longing, and the fire of battles fought side by side. Together, they unravel a conspiracy that threatens to consume two kingdoms, even as the greatest peril may lie within their own hearts. For in the clash between love and duty, archer and prince must choose: unite against the darkness, or be torn apart by the destiny that first made them enemies.

books.title: I Started Blowing Rainbow Farts at My Rival
books.author: Gu Sanyue
books.synopsis:
Jiang Qing was a natural-born actor, a child star by trade. But his tongue was far too sharp for his own good, and he managed to offend half the entertainment industry. In the end, he came crashing down spectacularly because of his rival, Lin Xun, toppling straight off his pedestal.
What he didn't expect was that the fall sent him tumbling back three years into the past, and with a bizarre new condition to boot: he stutters whenever he lies.
Since Heaven had seen fit to give him a second chance, he swore he would keep his head down and behave himself.
So his fans were baffled to discover that their beloved idol had not only lost his sharp tongue, he had also developed a stutter, and was now openly gushing about his rival.
Host: "What do you think of Lin Xun, your upcoming co-star?"
Jiang Qing: "He's g-gorgeous, k-kind, and t-talented, his acting is ab-ab-absolutely explosive, I'm his his his his biggest fan."
That day's trending search: #Jiang Qing riding the clout train, hands off our Xun Xun#
Meanwhile, the other party in question was watching the interview clip at home with a furrowed brow: "Who is this guy? I want his full profile in two minutes."
A few years later, when asked the same question again, Jiang Qing answered without a single stutter: "Pfft, you mean that guy with the pretty face and the garbage acting, the garbage talent? The one I could have kneeling in front of me and calling me daddy in ten seconds flat?"
Top trending: #Qingqing's counterattack fails again today! Xun has him locked down!#
Lin Xun saw the post, liked it with deep satisfaction, and went to throw out the kneeling board he kept at home.

books.title: The Tyrant Invades My Dream Every Night
books.author: 程十七
books.synopsis:
Fang Jiyao is the cherished daughter of the Minister of Revenue's household — gentle, quiet, and unassuming to a fault. Yet unbeknownst to anyone, she possesses a singular gift: the ability to control her own dreams.
One night, a young man wanders into her dreamscape.
Handsome and noble in bearing, with cool, refined features — he is precisely the manner of man she finds pleasing. And so, in a moment of weakness she cannot quite bring herself to regret, she pins him down within the dream, and what follows is tender and intoxicating.

At a palace banquet, Jiyao catches sight of the Son of Heaven seated in the place of highest honor — and goes cold. It is him. Her dream lover.
The Emperor's cruelty is known to all beneath the heavens.
Jiyao's heart hammers in her chest. She does not dare make a sound, and can only console herself in silence: It was only a dream. No one knows she once defiled the Emperor within it. She is still, outwardly, a composed and virtuous young lady of good family.
What she does not notice is that the moment the Emperor's gaze falls upon her, he crushes the delicate silver cup in his hand.
The young Emperor's lips curve into the faintest smile.
Good. I've finally found you in the flesh.
